_readme: Only add sources whose content is published FOR reuse, or whose legal notice does not forbid it: open licences (Creative Commons), statistics offices and public bodies. Read each site's 'Aviso legal' first.
Do NOT add other newspapers (Diario de Mallorca, Ultima Hora, Majorca Daily Bulletin, Mallorca Zeitung, etc.) or sites whose legal notice says reproduction needs written permission.
type 'rss': an RSS or Atom feed URL.  type 'html': a news LIST page plus linkPattern, a regular expression that matches the article links on that page.
enabled: true switches a source on.  category is only the fallback: the AI chooses the real section from the story.
mustMatch (optional): a regular expression; only stories that mention it are used (for national feeds).
firstRun (optional, html only): how many of the newest items to take the very first time (default 2).
maxPerRun limits how many stories one source can add each run (3 runs a day).
stripQuery (optional, html only): true removes ?parameters from the article links.
Credit lines and licence notices shown under articles are set in src/data/licences.ts (by website address).
